profiles.label: Full-service restaurants
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find incident reports with quoted count-bearing phrases such as "people were inside", "customers were inside", "patrons were inside", "diners were evacuated", or "inside the restaurant when" for full-service restaurants, cafes, diners, bistros, and family restaurants. Prioritize news articles, official reports, and official incident announcements; treat restaurant guides, review pages, directory listings, seating capacity, and generic venue pages as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
official health, fire, or code enforcement report
official restaurant statement with a count-bearing incident detail
context_only_source_types: restaurant directory, review, travel guide, listicle, or map listing
venue marketing or about page without a count-bearing event or incident
social media repost without an original authoritative source
